DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) with atypical DLCO findings.

While your symptoms, chest X-ray showing interstitial markings, and restrictive lung function (low FVC/FEV1) strongly suggest pulmonary fibrosis, the normal DLCO and lack of connective tissue disease markers are unusual. Given the chronic nature of your cough and the exclusion of other causes, I am proceeding with this diagnosis, though the normal diffusion capacity warrants close monitoring or reconsideration of the test methodology. Do you have any history of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) or heartburn?
